name: setup
about: LIVE prelude every live walk includes: install an app release from its archive into <out>/rig, join a live network by a single-use invite, install and run a member node, make a wallet (its recovery phrase is revealed to this rig only and held in memory), continue without an account, and wait until the console is open and every view it asked of the network has landed. WRITE-ONLY on the network: it spends the invite and runs a member node. Ends with the console open; teardown stops the app and the member node it started. A scenario that starts from an open console includes it; in a run of several it runs once.

params.release_archive: the app release archive, e.g. Ducktape-<rev>-linux-x86_64.tar.zst
params.release_key_file: file with the app release key (64 hex); a secret, compared to keys/release.pub
params.version: the version the installed launcher must report, e.g. 0.1.0+e0fbcb88
params.invite_file: file with the single-use invitation line (0600); a secret, never written anywhere
params.network: the network's workspace dir name the waiting step shows, e.g. dognet#b5b6ea90
params.node_archive: the member node release archive, e.g. ducktape-<rev>-linux-x86_64.tar.zst
params.node_release_key_file: file with the release key the member node's launcher pins (64 hex); a secret

steps.say: L1 the release archive is the one named
L1 make the unpack dirs
L1 unpack the release
L1 install with the release's own launcher
L1 the installed launcher reports the release's version
L1 state.json is idle
L1 state.json pins the release's sequence
L1 keys/release.pub is byte-equal to the key file
L2 boot the installed launcher
L2 the launch window offers Join with invitation
press Join with invitation
steps.expect: the invitation screen shows an Invitation field and a Join network button

steps.say: put the invitation into the Invitation field
steps.expect: the Join network button is enabled (no disabled state)

steps.say: press Join network
steps.expect: the app is setting up the network (a step such as Setting up your network or Waiting for your node) and shows no refusal or error sentence

steps.say: L2 the waiting step shows the node command block
L2 unpack the member node release
L2 install the member node as the waiting step says
L2 run the member node as the waiting step says
L2 the ready screen offers Open Ducktape (this step's ms = node start to ready)
press Open Ducktape
steps.expect: the Protect your wallet step shows, with Password and Confirm password fields (a password-length hint is not an error)

steps.say: put the wallet password into the Password field
put the wallet password into the Confirm password field
steps.expect: the Create wallet button is enabled (no disabled state)

steps.say: press Create wallet
steps.expect: the recovery phrase step shows (Write down your recovery phrase) with its words hidden

steps.say: remember the recovery phrase words the screen shows (the door reveals them to this rig only; held in memory, never written or sent)
press I wrote it down
steps.expect: the confirm step asks for the requested recovery words

steps.say: type the words the confirm step asks for (its prompt names their numbers) into the answer field
press Confirm recovery phrase
steps.expect: the account step shows (Your account); no error sentence

steps.say: the account step shows: Your account
continue without an account
steps.expect: the workspace console opens with its rail of tabs

steps.say: L2 the console is open (this step's ms = open to first tab)
every view the console asked of the network has landed: the rail's Loading views line clears
